Server/review.mjs uses a given --range verbatim, and its own refusal text suggests the two-dot form (michael/dev..worktree/<name>). A two-dot diff of a branch cut before newer michael/dev merges looks like it reverts them, so the reviewer may flag reverts that aren't there (seen on worktree/merge-list-module-tasks, 2026-10-23).
fix: In review.mjs, turn a two-dot range into three dots before diffing: const spec = range ? range.replace(/^([^.]+)\.\.(?!\.)/, "$1...") : ...; and change the refusal's example to michael/dev...worktree/<name>.

outcome.note: Server/review.mjs (053b06906): a two-dot --range becomes three dots before diffing; both refusal examples show michael/dev...worktree/<name>.

essence: Every worktree's dev server writes into tracked files.jsonl files (74 to 101 per worktree within minutes). The churn blocks `git merge` inside a worktree ("commit your changes or stash them") and blocks `git worktree remove`. On 2026-10-23 it hit worktree/qf-3 and worktree/smoke-ignored.
fix: A worktree's dev server should not write files.jsonl at all (they are listings the main tree keeps), or should write them to an ignored path. Fall back to `git update-index --skip-worktree` on them at worktree-up.

essence: Seven tests fail on michael/dev itself (the merge's near-tests run on 2026-10-23): fixer, TaskMove, landing-check, page_tools, global, item_tool, AskIndex-tasks. Merges no longer block on them, because they also fail on the base, so nobody is pushed to fix them.
fix: One cheap minion per failing test: get each one passing, or retire it with a reason. Then near-tests protects all 69.

essence: A freshly spawned minion's first prompt was blocked: "UserPromptSubmit hook callback timed out after 30000ms" (minion-qf3-work-tab, 2026-10-23 21:50 local). The minion went dormant having done nothing, and its parent got an empty "done:" report.
fix: Find which UserPromptSubmit hook took 30 s on a minion's first prompt; prompt-relay.mjs and the role reminder are candidates. Make it fail open: time-box it well under 30 s. Have Servex treat an empty first-turn report from a minion as a failed start (retry once), not as "done".

essence: append.mjs (Server/LogLine.mjs:31-36) stamps `at` on every line, including lines appended to a page.jsonl. On a page, Item.apply reads a top-level `at` as the old compat path key (core/Item/Item.js:119-124): the browser warns "no at target", and a nested `{content:{at,…}}` line is dropped. Seen 2026-10-23 on worktree/part-types (core/Page/parts/types/page.jsonl).
fix: When the target's basename is page.jsonl, LogLine stamps a top-level `ts` (as the item tool does) and never `at`. Alternative: refuse page.jsonl targets and point to the item tool.

outcome.note: Fixed in Server/LogLine.mjs (commit fae489967): a page.jsonl target gets a top-level ts, never at; other targets keep at. Documented in Server/doc/log-line.md.

essence: Fixed, FYI: `review.mjs <taskdir> <worktree> --range A..B` dropped the worktree argument (Server/review.mjs:703), so a page review screenshotted the main site, where an unmerged page is a 404, and the reviewer would judge a 404. Now a range keeps the worktree for the shots (michael/dev, the commit after 1f0eea774).
fix: Done on michael/dev: `else if (worktreeArg) worktreeDir = path.resolve(worktreeArg)`. Nothing more is needed unless the range should also read files from the worktree.

essence: A parent's reference line {"task":"<folder url>"} with no `as` makes a child with id "task" whenever the referenced log's line 1 has no id of its own (every task dir Servex opens on spawn). Two such references in one parent then collide: Session.apply_line / Task replay treat the second as "the same id moved home" and replace the first, so a child disappears and progress undercounts. Seen in core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/task.jsonl lines 82 and 91 (qf3-work-tab/ and nav-rule/): its replay shows one child {"id":"task"}.
fix: core/Task/Task.js:354, in from_ref: also rename the default id, i.e. `if (kid.id === "tasks" || kid.id === "task" || as) kid.id = id;` (Task.replay's fallback id is "task" at line 337), so the child takes ref_id(ref), its folder name. Add a Task.test check: two refs to id-less logs in one parent stay two children.

outcome.note: core/Task/Task.js from_ref (814456cad): an id-less referenced log (replay fallback id "task") now takes its folder name, so two refs in one parent stay two children. Task.test check added; it fails without the fix, 61/61 pass with it.
